fullPassage:
Dear Dog Owners,
My name is Lily Paxton, and I'm the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal to make the community more dog-friendly, we recently opened a new dog park. The park was designed to provide an enjoyable experience for both dogs and owners. There are big grassy areas where your dogs can run, jump, and play. We have separate spaces for small dogs and big dogs, to ensure safety. You'll also find lots of benches and areas for resting and staying cool. We hope you will have a wonderful time with your dogs in this newly opened park.
Regards,
Lily Paxton, Pet Program Coordinator

questions.passage: My name is Lily Paxton, and I'm the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal to make the community more dog-friendly, we recently ①<u>opened</u> a new dog park. The park was ②<u>designed</u> to provide an enjoyable experience for both dogs and owners. There are big grassy areas where your dogs can ③<u>runs</u>, jump, and play. We have separate spaces for small dogs and big dogs, to ④<u>ensure</u> safety.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①열었다 ②설계된 ③달리다(→run) ④보장하다
det.analysis:
✅ ③ runs → run: 조동사 can 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 함. can runs(×) → can run(○)
❌ ① opened: 과거시제 정상
❌ ② designed: 수동태 과거분사 정상
❌ ④ ensure: to부정사 뒤 동사원형 정상
det.tip: 조동사(can/will/may 등) + 동사원형. 3인칭 단수 -s 붙이지 않음

questions.passage: My name is Lily Paxton, and I'm the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal to make the community more ①<u>dog-friendly</u>, we recently opened a new dog park. The park was designed to provide an enjoyable experience for ②<u>both</u> dogs and owners. There are big grassy areas ③<u>which</u> your dogs can run, jump, and play. We have ④<u>separate</u> spaces for small dogs and big dogs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①반려견 친화적인 ②둘 다 ③~인(→where) ④별도의
det.analysis:
✅ ③ which → where: 선행사 areas(장소)에서 dogs can run이므로 장소 관계부사 where 필요. which를 쓰려면 in which
❌ ① dog-friendly: 복합형용사 정상
❌ ② both A and B: 정상 구문
❌ ④ separate: 형용사로 spaces 수식 정상
det.tip: 장소 선행사 + 관계부사 where = in which. areas where(○) / areas which(×)

questions.passage: My name is Lily Paxton, and I'm the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal ①<u>to make</u> the community more dog-friendly, we recently opened a new dog park. The park was designed to provide an ②<u>enjoyable</u> experience for both dogs and owners. You'll also find lots of benches and areas for ③<u>rest</u> and staying cool. We hope you will have a ④<u>wonderful</u> time with your dogs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①만들기 위해 ②즐거운 ③쉬다(→resting) ④멋진
det.analysis:
✅ ③ rest → resting: 전치사 for 뒤에 동명사(resting)가 와야 하며, and staying과 병렬 구조를 이루어야 함
❌ ① to make: 목적을 나타내는 to부정사 정상
❌ ② enjoyable: 형용사로 experience 수식 정상
❌ ④ wonderful: 형용사로 time 수식 정상
det.tip: 전치사 + 동명사: for resting and staying(○). 병렬 구조 주의

questions.passage: My name is Lily Paxton, and ①<u>I'm</u> the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal to make the community more dog-friendly, we recently opened a new dog park. The park ②<u>was designed</u> to provide an enjoyable experience for both dogs and owners. There are big grassy areas where your dogs can run, jump, and play. We have separate spaces for small dogs and big dogs, to ensure safety. You'll also find lots of benches and areas for resting and ③<u>stayed</u> cool. We hope you ④<u>will have</u> a wonderful time with your dogs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①나는 ~이다 ②설계되었다 ③머물렀다(→staying) ④~할 것이다
det.analysis:
✅ ③ stayed → staying: 전치사 for 뒤에서 resting and staying이 병렬 구조. stayed(과거형)는 동명사 resting과 병렬이 안 됨
❌ ① I'm: I am의 축약 정상
❌ ② was designed: 수동태 정상
❌ ④ will have: 미래시제 정상
det.tip: 병렬 구조: for resting and staying(○) / for resting and stayed(×). 같은 품사끼리 and로 연결

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 소형견과 대형견을 위한 __________ 공간이 있습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② separate: 안전을 위해 소형견과 대형견을 분리하므로 '별도의'
❌ ① identical(동일한) — 분리 취지에 반대
❌ ③ crowded(붐비는) — 안전과 관련 없음
❌ ④ temporary(임시의) — 맥락 무관
det.tip: separate spaces = 별도 공간. 소형견/대형견 분리 = 안전 확보

❌ ④ sandy(모래의) — 반려견 공원과 맞지 않음
det.tip: grassy areas = 잔디밭. 반려견이 run, jump, play하기 좋은 환경

questions.passage:
Dear Dog Owners,
My name is Lily Paxton, and I'm the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal to make the community more dog-friendly, we recently opened a new dog park. The park was designed to provide an enjoyable experience for both dogs and owners. There are big grassy areas where your dogs can run, jump, and play. We have separate spaces for small dogs and big dogs, to ensure safety. You'll also find lots of benches and areas for resting and staying cool. We hope you will have a wonderful time with your dogs in this newly opened park.
Regards,
Lily Paxton, Pet Program Coordinator
questions.stem:

"We recently __________ a new dog park."
(open을 알맞은 형태로 쓸 것)

det.korean: 우리는 최근에 새로운 반려견 공원을 __________했습니다.
det.analysis: ✅ opened: 과거시제. we recently opened a new dog park
